timer.name: autoclosevideoosd
timer.description: Timer to auto close the video OSD (if enabled in the skin settings)

timer.name: reset_osd_just_closed
timer.description: Clears the osd_just_closed flag ~1 second after VideoOSD closes, so a later pause gets a proper DialogSeekBar fade-in.

timer.name: addon_launcher_focus_rescue
timer.description: Returns focus to the add-on launcher menu when it lands on nothing visible, e.g. after a root's list empties and its menu item hides.
timer.start: Window.IsActive(1100) + !System.HasActiveModalDialog + !Control.HasFocus(9000) + !ControlGroup(700).HasFocus + ![[ControlGroup(501).HasFocus + Control.IsVisible(501)] | [ControlGroup(502).HasFocus + Control.IsVisible(502)] | [ControlGroup(503).HasFocus + Control.IsVisible(503)] | [ControlGroup(504).HasFocus + Control.IsVisible(504)] | [ControlGroup(505).HasFocus + Control.IsVisible(505)] | [ControlGroup(506).HasFocus + Control.IsVisible(506)] | [ControlGroup(507).HasFocus + Control.IsVisible(507)] | [ControlGroup(508).HasFocus + Control.IsVisible(508)]]
